title: Espaço Prelúdio — Virtual practice for healthcare professionals
metaDescription: Virtual practice for regulated healthcare professionals (psychologists, physicians, social workers, occupational therapists, speech therapists, nutritionists, dentists, PE professionals). End-to-end encrypted video, encrypted records, ICP-Brasil-signed e-prescriptions, and privacy by design.

faq.h2: Before you start, you'll want to know:
faq.q1: What if I lose the seed phrase that protects my records?
faq.a1Html: The seed phrase is generated on your device at first login and protects all encrypted notes (E2EE). We recommend exporting the encrypted backup (.epbk) as soon as you create your account — it's a file you store offline that contains the key and data in encrypted format. If you lose your main device, import the .epbk on the new one. Without the backup, encrypted records become inaccessible (that's the trade-off of real E2EE: even we can't open them).
faq.q2: How does automatic council validation work?
faq.a2: At signup, you enter your registration number from one of the 8 accepted councils (CRP, CRM, CRESS, CREFITO, CRFa, CRN, CRO, CREF). We query the council's public database in real time to confirm the registration exists, is active, and matches your name. Approval usually takes seconds. If the council's system is down, we do manual validation within 24h. Students submit an enrollment declaration (validated by AI).
faq.q3: Is the ICP-Brasil e-prescription accepted at pharmacies?
faq.a3: Yes. We use a legally valid ICP-Brasil certificate (MP 2.200-2/2001), the same standard recognized by pharmacies, government agencies, and the Federal Revenue. The prescription generated in Espaço Prelúdio includes a QR code for online validation and has the same legal standing as a paper prescription. Available for CRM and CREFITO on the Professional plan.
faq.q4: Does the patient need to install any app?
faq.a4: No. The patient joins via browser (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge) by clicking the unique link you send. Works on desktop, mobile and tablet. No mandatory signup — the patient can join as a guest or create an optional account for their own history. Zero friction.
faq.q5: Can I migrate records from another platform?
faq.a5: Currently in manual mode — you copy and paste each patient's content into the free-form notes. Bulk import via CSV or export from other platforms is on the roadmap (on demand; contact support if you have a large volume).
faq.a6: Receipts generated by the platform already include TUSS coding (Unified Supplementary Health Table) — the standard that insurers require for reimbursement. The patient receives a receipt ready to attach in their insurance app. Available on the Professional plan.
faq.q7: Why don't you charge a commission per session?
faq.a7: Because we think charging a percentage on clinical work is a marketplace structure, not a software one. A marketplace earns through transaction volume; software earns through value delivered per month. We're software. You set your rate, receive payment directly from the patient (Pix, card, transfer), and nothing goes through our server — we're just the tool.
faq.a8Html: Servers in Brazilian territory (AWS São Paulo), as required by LGPD Art. 33 for health data. Clinical notes and records are encrypted on your device before uploading — they arrive in our database already as an encrypted blob that even we can't read. Session video goes through a media server (LiveKit) with end-to-end WebRTC encryption; the content is encrypted in transit even internally.
faq.a9: Yes. 30 days free without entering a credit card. You use the full Professional plan during the period, with all features unlocked. If you cancel before the trial ends, no charge is made. If you decide to continue, you then set up your payment method.
faq.a10: You register the minor patient normally, with name, age and clinical data. The legal guardian receives each session link by email (configurable in the patient's profile) and must be present at the first appointment to authorize. A digital consent form is generated and stored encrypted in the record, in accordance with applicable regulations and the Brazilian Child and Adolescent Act.

differential.h2: Built with the clinic in mind, designed for your routine.
differential.card1Text: Lighting, typography and sounds designed to reduce fatigue across long sessions. Pick the mood — dusk, focus or calm — without the corporate-call aesthetic.
differential.card2Text: Everything you write during the session is encrypted in your browser before it leaves. Recovery via offline seed phrase.
differential.card3Text: Your patient joins via a unique, expiring link. No signup, no exposed history. The relationship is yours — not ours. Export your records whenever you want.

security.h2: End-to-end encryption, from start to finish.
security.lead: Psychotherapy data is sensitive health data. Our architecture was designed to protect you legally, not just technically.
security.card1Text: Every audio and video frame is encrypted via WebRTC Encoded Transforms before leaving the browser. The LiveKit server routes opaque bytes — it can't watch the session.
security.card2Text: Your notes are encrypted with a key derived from your password (PBKDF2, 200,000 iterations). You receive a unique seed phrase at signup — keep it offline. Without it and your password, no one can access them.
security.card3Text: Patient consent signed on each entry, audit log of what was accessed and when, encrypted PDF record export for retention per professional councils (20 years).

plans.h2: Pay for the software. Not for your billable hour.
plans.lead: No commission, no per-session fee. Charge your patient whatever you want.
